//: Only package.json is managed here on purpose.
src-tauri/Cargo.toml and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json carry the same
version, and release.yml rewrites both from package.json immediately
before it builds. Doing it there rather than here avoids release-please's
TOML extra-file support, which rejected a plain xpath and failed the
whole action with a JSONPath error.
The sync lives in the release workflow rather than in CI because the
build is what needs the three files to agree; leaving them out of sync on
main is harmless as long as release.yml fixes them before packaging.
